rule.statement: A court should insist on a due compliance with the requirement that the land surveyed by a surveyor must conform substantially with the land as described in the plaint, regarding location, boundaries, and extent.
rule.supporting_quote: If the land surveyed is substantially different from the land as described in the schedule to the plaint, the Court has to decide at that stage whether to issue instructions to the surveyor to carry out a fresh survey in conformity with the commission or whether the action should be proceeded with in respect of the land surveyed.
